units.source_text: 真想获得更加轻盈的空气呀！

en.t: How he longed for lighter air!

units.source_text: 至少希望得到没有混杂自己吐出气息的新鲜空气！

en.t: At the very least, he wanted fresh air that was not mixed with the breath he himself had exhaled!

units.source_text: 一天一次，哪怕只有三十分钟也可以，

en.t: Once a day, even if it was only for thirty minutes,

units.source_text: 如果能够登崖望海，那该是多么美好的事情哇。

en.t: if he could climb up the cliff and look out at the sea, what a wonderful thing that would be.

units.source_text: 这样的要求应该得到允许吧。

en.t: Surely a request like that ought to be allowed.
After all, the village was tightly guarded,

units.source_text: 如果再考虑到他三个多月来老老实实干活的表现，

en.t: and if they also took into account how obediently he had worked for more than three months,

units.source_text: 这不是极其正常的要求吗？

en.t: was this not an entirely reasonable request?

units.source_text: 也有权利得到活动时间呀。

en.t: had the right to be given time for exercise.
